description: Price, daily change, day and 52-week range, market cap, valuation (P/E, forward P/E, EPS, dividend yield), company profile (sector, industry, CEO, employees, description), revenue and margins, the next earnings date and the ETFs that hold it, for one stock or ETF. Includes the as-of time and source.

symbol.description: Ticker symbol, e.g. NVDA, SPY or BRK.B. Index symbols use ^, e.g. ^GSPC.
